channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: 'Going Cantore': Tom Abbott, Karen Stupples show why LPGA play called
item.description: Play was called Saturday at the 2026 Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions. Golf Channel on-course reporters Tom Abbott and Karen Stupples show why the 17th green was unplayable because of the high winds.

item.title: Plenty of birdies and bogeys: Brooks Koepka shoots wild 1-over 73 Saturday at Farmers
item.description: Brooks Koepka started his third round at Torrey Pines South Course with a bogey and a double bogey — foreshadowing an up-and-down day for the five-time major winner who shot par on just eight holes Saturday.

item.title: Farmers Insurance Open 2026: Final round tee times, groupings, how to watch
item.description: The Farmers Insurance Open continues at Torrey Pines on Sunday. Here's everything you need to know about the final round.

item.title: LPGA Highlights 2026: Hilton Grand Vacations TOC, Round 3
item.description: Highlights from the third round of the LPGA's Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions, where high winds and cold conditions eventually led to the suspension of play -- but not before Nelly Korda fired 64. Catch all the Saturday action from Lake Nona.

item.title: Rose not complacent with six-shot lead at Farmers
item.description: Todd Lewis catches up with Justin Rose, who leads by six shots through 54 holes of the 2026 Farmers Insurance Open. The Englishman says he is trying to not think too far ahead on Sunday.

item.title: 'No one's beating him': Justin Rose stretches Farmers lead to six, eliminates nearly all hope
item.description: Justin Rose had another impeccable day with the irons, and his 4-under 68 Saturday gave him a six-shot lead at the Farmers Insurance Open, where even second-place Joel Dahmen is already feeling defeated.

item.title: Frigid temperatures impact Sunday schedule for LPGA at TOC
item.description: Amy Rogers reports from Lake Nona where freezing temperatures Sunday in Orlando, Florida, will impact the LPGA's schedule for the conclusion of Round 3 and the final-round start to the Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions.

item.title: Koepka struggles with putter in Round 3 at Torrey Pines
item.description: Brooks Koepka finished with a 1-over 73 at Torrey Pines South Course on Saturday, mimicking his first round score and sinking him down on the leaderboard at the Farmers. Koepka's struggles putting continued in Round 3.

item.title: Moving Day: Rose putting on a 'clinic' at Farmers
item.description: Justin Rose is putting on a "clinic" at the Farmers Insurance Open, according to PGA Tour pro and "Golf Central" analyst Steve Marino. He moved six clear of the field on Moving Day.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: Farmers Insurance Open, Round 3
item.description: Watch the best shots and moments from the third round of the PGA Tour's 2026 Farmers Insurance Open at Torrey Pines.
